name: Issue 5628: Leyfeed steals from Arcane Nullifier X-21 but is reflected by Reflection Field
contract: #5628 reports that Leyfeed 520269 cannot steal Arcane Nullifier X-21's (6232) reflect buff. Its SmartAI casts
Reflection Field 10831 on itself: Dispel magic, SPELL_AURA_REFLECT_SPELLS BasePoints 99 = 100%, 5 s, caster
and nearby allies. Leyfeed is SPELL_EFFECT_STEAL_BENEFICIAL_BUFF on TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY, DmgClass magic,
without SPELL_ATTR0_IS_ABILITY or SPELL_ATTR1_NO_REFLECTION, so Spell.cpp marks it reflectable and a 100%
reflect sends it back to its caster, where a steal from oneself does nothing. The same holds for Spellsteal
30449. Expected: Leyfeed steals a magic buff from the Nullifier without Reflection Field; with Reflection Field
up Leyfeed is reflected and the Nullifier keeps both Reflection Field and its other magic buff.

steps.label: Let login hooks and fixture AI settle
The Nullifier buffs itself with Power Word: Fortitude
SETUP: the Nullifier holds Power Word: Fortitude
CONTROL: Leyfeed steals the magic buff
CONTROL: the Nullifier lost the stolen buff
SETUP: Power Word: Fortitude is up
CONTRACT: the reflected Leyfeed steals no Reflection Field
CONTRACT: the Nullifier keeps Reflection Field
CONTRACT: the Nullifier keeps its other magic buff
